reason: marko-bug: Mismatched group, same root cause as define-block -- a <define> immediately followed by a bare top-level placeholder ($!{...}) with no wrapping tag throws "Mismatched group. A closing \"}\" character was found but it is not matched with a corresponding opening character." in @marko/compiler 5.42.5 / marko@6.3.51's own parser, reproduced without <fragment> or any MX-specific syntax. Genuine upstream Marko parser limitation (decision 65's "target cannot" class).
